title: Cayley, Dedekind, and Dirichlet: Classical Algebra and Arithmetic LaTeX Drafts
version: 2026-06-02 Dirichlet Band II Papers I-X and Dedekind/Dirichlet LII-LIX
description:
This record is a public-facing shelf for modern LaTeX working drafts of selected classical algebra, arithmetic, and number-theory manuscripts by Arthur Cayley, Richard Dedekind, and P. G. Lejeune Dirichlet. Top-level PDFs are organized by author, work, and usable slice so readers can download individual files directly. Source TeX, build notes, audit outputs, scan witnesses, and provenance material are collected in ZIP artifacts.

Status at a glance.

  • Cayley front-facing reader surface: [##--------] 13 volume-level source-checked readers are promoted as direct top-level files. Volume I now has complete source-label coverage (pages 1-573) after six 2026-06-02 gap fills; the remaining Cayley volumes remain slice readers built from the current repaired/retyped source ranges.
  • Cayley broader working material: [#########-] the large artifact ZIP preserves source trees, broad working PDFs, TeX chunks, rendered slice PDFs, and audit material for continuation.
  • Dedekind: [####------] the shelf includes a complete German/English source-checked edition of Was sind und was sollen die Zahlen? and the current Dedekind/Dirichlet prefaces and notices lane through items LII-LIX, with TeX, scan witnesses, and render checks in the GitHub source layer.
  • Dirichlet: [###-------] the current dedicated Band II packet covers Papers I-X in original languages and English translation, including individual TeX/PDF readers and combined cumulative PDFs. The older selected-works reader remains a broad working draft rather than the current source of truth.
  • Mathematical proofreading: [----------] working drafts for checking and correction, not certified critical editions.

Workflow. Public-domain scans and witnesses are converted into TeX drafts, checked into readable PDFs, and packaged with source artifacts for inspection and correction. Large raw/provenance material remains on the main project preservation record; this shelf stays reader-facing and comparatively lean.
notes: Focused public-facing working-draft shelf for Cayley, Dedekind, and Dirichlet. Latest update promotes Dirichlet Werke Band II Papers I-X and Dedekind/Dirichlet prefaces and notices LII-LIX while preserving broader Cayley source inventory and repair material.
